IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives McCune, Warnick, Haler, Campbell, Dunn, and Roach

Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting school construction projects from sales and use taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting school construction projects fromsales and use taxes; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofmaterials, labor, equipment, contracts, and components used forconstructing, repairing, decorating, or improving public schoolbuildings, playgrounds, physical education and athletic facilities, andstructures authorized by law or necessary or proper to carry out thefunctions of a public school to the extent provided in subsections (1)through (5) of this section. For the purposes of this section, "publicschool" has the same meaning as in RCW 28A.150.010. (1) In fiscal year 2009, twenty percent of the tax rate provided inRCW 82.08.020; (2) In fiscal year 2010, forty percent of the tax rate provided inRCW 82.08.020; p. 1 HB 3111 (3) In fiscal year 2011, sixty percent of the tax rate provided inRCW 82.08.020; (4) In fiscal year 2012, eighty percent of the tax rate provided inRCW 82.08.020; and (5) In fiscal year 2013, one hundred percent of the tax rateprovided in RCW 82.08.020.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof materials, labor, equipment, contracts, and components used forconstructing, repairing, decorating, or improving public schoolbuildings, playgrounds, physical education and athletic facilities, andstructures authorized by law or necessary or proper to carry out thefunctions of a public school to the extent provided in section 1 ofthis act. For the purposes of this section, "public school" has thesame meaning as in RCW 28A.150.010.
